title: MP-AIX Ph.D. Program
about: Second-cohort call of the Max Planck Artificial Intelligence Network PhD program, starting in 2027. Applications go through a joint ELLIS and MP-AIX portal; one application can be considered for either program or both.
requirements: Candidates already employed in a prospective advisor's group cannot receive MP-AIX funding
Reference requests must be sent through the portal before the deadline

upskill.name: the course catalog
why: Field "Artificial intelligence" -> catalog of AI academies; the shortlist scores came only from generic terms ("program", "artificial", "intelligence").

Stated requirements ("Candidates already employed in a prospective advisor's group cannot receive MP-AIX funding", "Reference requests must be sent through the portal before the deadline") are eligibility rules that no course objective covers, so no specific course is claimed.
